description: Enables block-level comments, text-anchor comments, page-level comments, reactions, and read-tracking in TmNotionEditor. All comment UI (thread panel, badges, hover indicators) is hidden when this provider is not supplied.

methods.name: GetBlockCommentsAsync
methods.description: Returns all comment threads attached to a specific block.

methods.name: AddBlockCommentAsync
methods.description: Creates a new comment thread on a block.

methods.name: ReplyToCommentAsync
methods.description: Adds a reply to an existing comment thread.

parameters.name: parentEntryId
parameters.description: For threaded replies; null for top-level reply.

methods.name: EditCommentAsync
methods.description: Updates the HTML content of an existing comment entry.

methods.name: DeleteCommentAsync
methods.description: Deletes an entire comment thread.

methods.name: DeleteCommentEntryAsync
methods.description: Deletes a single reply within a comment thread.

methods.name: ResolveCommentAsync
methods.description: Marks a comment thread as resolved.

methods.name: UnresolveCommentAsync
methods.description: Re-opens a resolved comment thread.

methods.name: AddTextAnchorCommentAsync
methods.description: Creates a comment anchored to a specific text range within a block (Cmd+Shift+M shortcut).

parameters.name: startOffset
parameters.description: Character offset of the selection start.

parameters.name: endOffset
parameters.description: Character offset of the selection end.

parameters.name: highlightedText
parameters.description: The selected plain text (shown in comment thread header).

parameters.name: commentId
parameters.description: Client-generated ID for the comment thread.

methods.name: GetPageCommentsAsync
methods.description: Returns page-level comment threads (shown in the Page Comments panel).

methods.name: AddPageCommentAsync
methods.description: Creates a new page-level comment thread.

methods.name: GetUnresolvedCommentsCountAsync
methods.description: Returns the count of unresolved comment threads for the given page. Used to populate the comment badge in the editor header.

methods.name: MarkThreadAsReadAsync
methods.description: Marks all entries in a comment thread as read for the given user.

methods.name: MarkThreadAsUnreadAsync
methods.description: Marks a comment thread as unread for the given user.

methods.name: MarkAllThreadsAsReadAsync
methods.description: Marks all comment threads on a block or page as read for the given user.

methods.name: GetReactionsAsync
methods.description: Returns all emoji reactions on a specific comment entry.

methods.name: AddReactionAsync
methods.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a comment entry.

methods.name: RemoveReactionAsync
methods.description: Removes an emoji reaction from a comment entry.

methods.name: SubscribeToThreadAsync
methods.description: Subscribes the given user to a comment thread for notifications.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromThreadAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes the given user from a comment thread.
